City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 24, 2019 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by San Diego Humane Society Animal Services
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-04-24 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Appointment to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (Leucadia representative) to fill one unscheduled vacancy. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Mary L. Schultz to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (Leucadia representative) with a term ending March 2020 to fill one unscheduled vacancy created by the resignation of Darius Degher.
2019-04-24 Item 08B Unscheduled Vacancy Traffic and Public Safety Commission - Redacted
8C.
Legislative position letter in support of AB 1730. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Approve the legislation position letter in support of AB 1730.
2019-04-24 Item 08C Legislative Position Letter in Support of AB 1730
8D.
An amendment to the existing Civic Solutions, Inc. contract agreement for additional Planner support for the remainder of Fiscal Year 2018-19 in the amount of $30,000. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa’u
Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment #3 with Civic Solutions, Inc. substantial in form in consultation with the City Attorney, adding an additional $30,000 to the contract, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $246,000.
2019-04-24 Item 08D Civic Solutions Contract
8E.
List of Projects funded by SB1 (The Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017) for Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-18 entitled, "Resolution of the City of Encinitas Adopting a List of Projects for Fiscal Year 2019-20 Funded by SB1: The Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017".
2019-04-24 Item 08E SB1 Funding
8F.
Renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-15 entitled, “Resolution of Intention to Order the Renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District for FY 2019/20”; and 2) Set the public hearing for May 22, 2019.
2019-04-24 Item 08F Encinitas Landscape Lighting District
8G.
Continued public hearing from March 13, 2019 to consider and approve Resolution No. 2019-23 approving the Fiscal Year (FY) 2019-20 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program budget and the FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan. Contact Person: Contract Management Analyst Melander
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-23 approving the proposed FY 2019-20 CDBG budget and FY 2019-20 Action Plan; 2) Authorize the City Manager to transmit the FY 2019-20 Action Plan and execute required certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); and 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute all funding agreements and documents consistent with the FY 2019-20 Action Plan.
2019-04-24 Item 08G CDBG FY 2019-20 Annual Action Plan
8H.
Fiscal Year 2018-19 Mid-Year Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments and Personnel Changes. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Mid-Year Budget Status Report; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-29 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget"; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-30 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving Personnel Changes in the Development Services and Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Departments and Adopting Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2018-19"
2019-04-24 Item 08H FY18-19 Mid-Year Agenda Report
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.

Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of the La Costa 48 project to subdivide three existing lots into 48 residential lots (44 market rate and 4 very low affordable lots) utilizing the State Density Bonus Law and construction of grading/utilities, storm water, and landscaping improvements. CASE NUMBER: 15-222 TMDB/DR/CDP; APPLICANT: DCM Properties, Inc., David Meyer; APPELLANT: Batiquitos Lagoon Foundation (BLF) David Hill & Fred Sandquist; LOCATION: 510, 512 & 514 La Costa Avenue (APN: 216-030-45, -46 & -10). Contact Person: Principal Planner Yentile
Deny the appeal and adopt the draft City Council Resolution No. 2019-27 upholding the Planning Commission's decision to approve the project and to certify the Final "Environmental Impact Report (EIR).

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
